cross_verification.note_en: Saudi passports are issued via the Absher platform (Ministry of Interior). Multiple direct fetch attempts on absher.sa, moi.gov.sa (including a passport-services PDF), my.gov.sa, and mofa.gov.sa's Fanar portal either returned 403 Forbidden / connection errors, or only navigational/login content with no readable photo-specification text. Search-engine synopses referenced figures such as '2 colored 4×6cm photos, white background' attributed to my.gov.sa/moi.gov.sa, but since the underlying page content could not be independently opened and read, these figures are not included as verified per the sourcing policy — only actually-read official page content is recorded here.
